description: Five gates flipped by hand, each one holding its last state until a sample-and-hold trigger lets the new one through

params.text: Chooses whether a row takes up its button only while both its own S&H jack and GLOBAL S&H are at or above 1V, or while either one of them is
Flips this row's gate open or closed; the flip reaches the output only while the row is free to take it up

inputs.text: At or above 1V the rows take up whatever their buttons have been set to; below that the rows are held
The signal this row gates, passed through while the gate is open and silenced while it is closed
At or above 1V this row takes up whatever its button has been set to; below that the row is held

outputs.text: This row's gated signal, or a flat 10V gate while nothing is patched to that row's TOMUTE jack

notes: all five gates come up closed, so every output is at 0V until a button is pressed.
with neither S&H jack patched a button takes effect the moment it is pressed.
the small pink light on a row comes on while a button has been pressed and the flip has not been let through yet.
